unlisted_practices: Rubric-based LLM evaluation is insensitive to injected clinically relevant hallucinations, so rubric scores alone are insufficient to establish clinical reliability
Retrieval-based factuality check as a complement to rubric scoring recovers some rubric-blind errors
Use more specific, fact-checking rubrics to better distinguish correct from hallucinated responses

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates evaluation and validation practices (rubric-based evaluation and retrieval-based factuality checking safeguards) for catching clinically relevant hallucinations in medical LLMs across multiple benchmarks.

primary.practice: retrieval-based factuality check and specific rubric-based validation
